description: The second Surge reverb: a pre-delay into a diffusing tail with its own modulation and separate damping of high and low frequencies.

params.text: Sets the gap between the dry signal and the start of the reverb, 0.0625 to 2 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the size of the room, -100% to 100%.
Sets how long the tail takes to fade, 0.0625 to 64 seconds.
Sets how much the early echoes are smeared into each other, 0 to 100%.
Sets how quickly the tail thickens after the reverb starts, 0 to 100%.
Sets how much the delay lines inside the reverb are modulated, 0 to 100%.
Sets how quickly low frequencies fade out of the tail, 0 to 100%.
Sets how quickly high frequencies fade out of the tail, 0 to 100%.
Sets the stereo width of the reverb, -24dB to 24dB.
Sets how much reverb is mixed with the dry input, 0 to 100%.
Nothing in the module reads this knob; this reverb has ten parameters and the panel carries twelve knobs.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.
Switches the pre-delay from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by clock cv.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the Pre-Delay knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Room Size knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Decay Time knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Diffusion knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Buildup knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Modulation knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the LF Damping knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the HF Damping knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Width knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Mix knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; this reverb has ten parameters and the panel carries twelve CV jacks.
Sets the tempo that tempo-synced times follow, doubling with every volt from 60 BPM at 0V, so 1V gives 120 BPM; with nothing patched the tempo is 120 BPM.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
